annotations.title: Assess a tattoo idea's size, placement and style

description: Use when the user describes a specific tattoo idea and asks whether it will hold up at a given size and body placement. Compares the design with published minimum sizes for its kind of design and returns the placement's fade, sun, friction, stretch and curvature estimates, style notes, things to look at and questions for the artist. Lettering is sized by capital letter height (letter_height_mm); everything else by the longest side (size_cm). It does not generate designs, look at images, or give medical advice.

design_type.description: Kind of design: block_capitals (capital letters), script_lettering, eye, bold_symbol_or_short_word (silhouette, simple symbol), fine_botanical (flower or plant with veins/stamens), moderate_detail (two line weights, simple shading), realistic_face, realism_japanese_or_dense_floral.

letter_height_mm.description: Height of a capital letter in millimetres. Use for block_capitals and script_lettering.

placement.description: Body area, if the user has one in mind.

size_cm.description: Longest side of the whole design in centimetres. Use for every design_type except block_capitals and script_lettering.

style.description: Tattoo style, if the user has one in mind.
